description: Star rating: shows a score with fractions and the number of reviews, or lets people pick one.

howToUse: Show the score of a product, place or answer with `readOnly`, `value` and `count`. Fractions such as 4.5 fill part of a star.
Without `readOnly` it becomes a radio group: people pick from 1 to `max`, and clicking the chosen star again clears it.
Keep the number next to the stars (`showValue`) when the exact score matters; stars alone round in people's heads.
`showLabel` shows the label above the stars, as in a review summary; without it the label is only read aloud.
alternatives: A score with no stars, such as an NPS or a percentage: Stat or ScoreGauge.
A choice among named levels: Segmented or RadioGroup.

keyboard.action: Moves into the group, onto the chosen star.
Changes the rating by one star.
Goes to the lowest or highest rating.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled rating, from 0 to `max`. Read-only accepts fractions (4.5); picking uses whole stars.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the chosen rating. Without it and without `readOnly`, the rating still changes internally.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.
